name: Shakshuka
instructions: Saute diced onion and garlic until soft.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in chopped spinach until wilted.
Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until whites set, 5-6 minutes.
Crumble feta over the top if you have it, and serve.
ranking_rationale: No candidate rescued item is high_risk, so safety does not gate the ranking. Shakshuka rescues 3 of the pantry's at-risk items (sealed tomatoes nearing donation-eligible age, depleting eggs, low-confidence spinach with a day left) against only 1 missing ingredient, and a 25-minute one-pan prep — the best rescue-to-gap ratio among candidates considered.
